_readme: Horror director role cards (Survivors mod, horror/Director.java). Edit and run /director reload; no rebuild. Cards are matched in order, first match wins. tier: headline (one per group per night, budgeted), ambient (small scares, ambientPerHour), infection (only grace + a colony buffer; Spore runs itself), ignore (director never touches it). grace: general (graceDays) | infection (infectionGraceDays) | none. target: nearest | alone | grouped | loot | colony. needs are checked on the targeted player (and the spawn spot for dark/underground/minDistance). weight = chance an attempt passes per evaluation window, by tension band. stage = how the FIRST appearance per player is staged: hidden + frozen for leadSeconds (sound plays, crew whisper), then visible and still for seconds, then removed. Tunable numbers (budget, warm-up, grace days) are in /survivors set (Tuning).

flags._readme: Persistent flags (SettlementData or /director flag) and what they do: silence = no horrors at all, no_infection = no infection spawns, end_grace = grace over now, ambient_only = no headline scares, no_director = only the grace rule, keep_it_lit = Act 6 'Keep It Lit' (no general horrors in block light 8+ or within 128 blocks of the Engine), let_it_rest = Act 6 'Let It Rest' (no infection within 160 blocks of the Engine, 3 in 4 cancelled elsewhere, spore:proto exempt). engine_turning / engine_stopped are set by kubejs engine.js together with /director engine <dim> <x> <y> <z>; if a file lacks them the director adds them.

cards.name: kenny
cards.note: Stalker. Its campaign (huntStartDay 20, watch/spawn delays, footsteps, whispers, heartbeat, sleep watching) lives in kenny.json; the director only gates the Kenny entity: alone, outside a colony, first sighting staged at 24+ blocks. Removing a staged Kenny makes his own scheduler wait respawnAfterLostTargetSeconds (3600).

cards.name: weeping_angel
cards.note: Spawns only where it is dark (spawn spot light <= 7) and the player carries or stands in light, so they can notice it. Natural spawn weight/caps stay in weeping-angels-spawns.toml.

cards.name: cave_dweller
cards.whisper: Hear that? Down in the tunnels.
cards.note: Underground only (player below y 50 with no sky light). Its own timers (canSpawnMin/Max, noise) keep running; the director just refuses attempts that do not fit. Day or night does not matter underground.

cards.name: knocker
cards.note: Only when everyone in the group is inside (no sky above them) after dark. Its stalk/looked/swim forms count as one scare (continuation).

cards.name: boy_and_bath
cards.whisper: I don't like how quiet it is.
cards.note: Sleep/stalk event. Night and a lone player. Its story/sleep timers stay in The Boy And The Bath spawnrate.toml.

cards.name: scp_headline
cards.whisper: Something big is moving out there.
cards.note: The dangerous SCPs: a group scare, at night, away from the colony.

cards.name: scp_ambient
cards.note: The rest of SCP: Ultimate's 277 mobs, kept to the ambient budget. Friendly NPCs and pets are excluded.

cards.name: arphex
cards.note: Phobia mobs, ambient budget, dark spots only. Helper entities (AI controllers, spawners, clones) are never touched. Its own dimension (the Webrooms) is skipped.

cards.name: watcher_shadow
cards.note: The shadow figure TheWatcher spawns once fear passes shadowFearThreshold. The fear bar, animal staring, action echoes and environmental events are its own (thewatcher-common.properties, mostly client side); the director can only gate the shadow entity.

cards.name: backwoods
cards.note: Story location mobs; inside its own dimensions the director never interferes (skipDimensions).

cards.name: infection
cards.note: Spore, Spore Inquisition and Infection Nexus run themselves (spread, ordeals, evolution). The director only applies the 5-day grace and refuses infected spawns within colonyBuffer blocks of a colony or settlement. It never budgets them.
